guide_solution: (a) The empowerment of women is an important aspect in the concept of both global and national development. (b) So, women development and the empowerment of women are the inevitable factors which are to be guaranteed in all levels of state administration. (c) It is a happy news that womenfolk can be turned into an asset by ensuring their active involvement in the affairs of the state. (d) The overall development of some developing countries like Bangladesh is impossible if there is no participation of women in all sectors. (e) But it is true that there are a lot of hindrances which women have to overcome to go forward. → → → → → → →
